text:
JWT `exp` in **seconds**. `Date.now()` in **milliseconds**.

**Bug:**
```js
if (Date.now() > payload.exp) // wrong — always false, exp looks huge
```

**Fix:**
```js
if (Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) > payload.exp) // correct
```

Or:
```js
if (Date.now() > payload.exp * 1000) // also correct
```

**Why tokens pass:** `Date.now()` ≈ `1700000000000`, `exp` ≈ `1700000000`. Left always bigger → condition never true → all tokens "valid".

Recommend `jsonwebtoken` lib — handles unit mismatch, clock skew, alg validation auto.
